title: Ames Plant Director
text:
For our client, we are seeking a Ames Plant Director to join the team of a leader in the Business Services space.
 
 
This role will lead plant operations with a strong focus on safety, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement. The director will partner across functions to strengthen supply chain performance, build strong teams, and support operational goals in a complex manufacturing environment. The position also plays a key role in budgeting, compliance, and workforce culture.
 
 
The ideal candidate will bring deep manufacturing leadership experience and a track record of driving results through disciplined execution and inclusive leadership. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can balance day-to-day plant performance with longer-term strategic planning. Success in the role will require close collaboration with cross-functional teams and a commitment to operational excellence.
 
 
Location: Westchester, IL
 
 
Compensation: $250,253 – $305,864 annually
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team to produce products that enhance lives globally
* Drive operational excellence at the plant
* Oversee environmental health and safety practices
* Enhance supply chain performance to support customer satisfaction
* Develop strategic plans and budgets that support continuous improvement
* Champion inclusive workplace programs
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies and safety standards

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution is required
* Ten years of experience in quality, product/process/project engineering, or manufacturing
* Five years of management experience in a manufacturing setting
* Plant Manager experience in complex organizations is preferred
* Strong leadership track record in high-performance team settings
* Certification in Lean Six Sigma methodologies is advantageous
* Experience in operational excellence and financial accounting is beneficial

**Benefits**

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts
* Disability and life insurance options
* Paid absences and retirement benefits
* Relocation assistance available

Our client is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification—your background could be exactly what this team needs.
